title: System One
tagline: A free, animated course on decision models: typed judgments, calibrated probabilities, and software that decides.
description: Learn to build with System One decision models like TypeSafe's Jev, OpenAI's Decisions API, Cloudflare's Clef and AWS's Strands Decider. 22 short animated lessons on typed questions, calibrated probabilities, thresholds, composition patterns and evaluation, distilled from the docs, 57 talks and 70+ articles and papers, plus original measurements. Free and open source, and your agent can take it too.
